title: Docket
description: A regulatory docket grouping related federal regulatory documents on Regulations.gov.

agencyId.description: The acronym used to abbreviate the name of the agency associated with the docket.

highlightedContent.description: Content highlighted by search engine for the searchTerm.

lastModifiedDate.description: The date docket was last modified in the system.

objectId.description: The internal ID of the docket in our system.

title.description: The formal title of the docket.

dkAbstract.description: The detailed description of the docket.

effectiveDate.description: The date the docket is put into effect.

keywords.description: Agency selected keywords associated with a docket.

rin.description: OMB issued Regulation Identifier Number (RIN) uniquely identifies a docket and its documents.

program.description: The agency specific program associated with the docket.

shortTitle.description: A combination of letters and or numbers assigned to an agency's regulatory action for purposes of brevity.

modifyDate.description: The date when the docket was last modified.

organization.description: Identifies docket's (a regulatory action) originating agency and/or department.
